title: silicone edge universal lid
text: silicone edge universal lid. I just purchased a new pan set and the fry pans never come with lids that fit.  Why is that?  I am not sure.  But in any case, I really like these lids.  The silicone edge helps them stay on the pan effectively.  There is a steam release hole ... the main body of the lid is glass ( really useful to see what's happening without lifting) and the knob is silicone - so you can grab it without burning yourself.  I purchased one a while ago that had a metal handle, didn't think anything of it until I tried to lift it off the pan once.  Yikes!  They (I purchased a smaller one too) wash up beautifully in the dishwasher or by hand.  Now, having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

Does that pile of pot lids on your shelf annoy you each time you open your cabinet door?
Are your old and lonely cookware collecting dust as they mourn their missing lids?
Enter Bezrat universal replacement cover
, an innovative addition to your culinary collection. It
helps you eliminate the chaos in your kitchen drawers and become super-organized!
QUALITY AND DESIGN
The universal pot lid is made of superior tempered glass and rimmed with firm silicone to protect
its edges. The glass offers an easy way to see your pot contents at all times!
HEAT RESISTANT KNOB

UNIVERSAL SIZE

solution to keeping your kitchen tidy. By using one great cover instead of many, you'll save your
space, time and energy for the things that really matter!
